comparison.objective: Open a railcar knuckle and push a car into it to couple; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests latch opening, heavy-object pushing, alignment, and coupling; candidate tests recessed tool engagement, counterholding, fine collar rotation, locking torque, and iterative impact tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the car coupled after opening the knuckle; candidate requires two safe dynamic stops plus a drift-resistant locked setting.
comparison.reason: Mechanical coupling has a different end state and mechanism from damping adjustment. No spec versions or coupling-latch, force, and damage thresholds are stated.
